issue_notes: No. 138 (1903 Q2): no arms-trade rows found. The Kowloon import table in this issue does not list Saltpetre or Sulphur (the Foreign Sundries list runs Rice and Paddy, Sandalwood, Sapanwood, Seaweed, Stock-fish), although both reappear in the 1903 Q4 figures printed in No. 144, so the 1903 Q2 quantities are unknown; check the scan. Keyword hits in this issue are antimony and arsenic ores, joss-stick powder and month headings misread as 'Arms', none of which are arms trade.
No. 138: Tientsin Native Customs saltpetre export (59 piculs) added from the comparison column of No. 142.
